newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks hold gains to close higher.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks hold gains to close higher.

text.p: Toronto stocks held onto strong early gains Monday, driven by interest in several large issues and a year-end portfolio shuffle at mutual funds, traders said.
The TSE 300 Composite Index rose 51.64 points to 5,954.25 in brisk turnover of 763 million shares.
Advancing stocks led declines 585 to 340 with 276 issues unchanged.
"I think it's people getting into the market before the January and February (retirement fund investment) rush comes along," said Fred Ketchen, senior vice-president of ScotiaMcLeod Inc.
Such large-cap issues as Potash Corp. of Saskatchewan Inc., Imperial Oil Ltd., Thomson Corp., and Bank of Nova Scotia shot higher in brisk trading.
Potash added 4 to 117 while Imperial added 1.65 to 64.40. Media and travel giant Thomson rose 1.65 to 30.50 and ScotiaBank added 0.85 to 46.50.

The communications and media group rose 240.60, or 2.4 percent, to 10,202.54. Several stocks in the sector were given a boost after Merrill Lynch initiated coverage on a number of Canadian cable companies.
